Juror Explains Holdout Vote in Lindsay Clancy Trial

A holdout juror in the Lindsay Clancy trial, Michael P. Desronvil, stated in a Fox News interview that he believed the defendant, Lindsay Clancy, had acted "methodically" in the killing of her three children. Desronvil cited this perceived methodical nature as a primary reason for his desire to see Clancy convicted. He also reported feeling harassed as the lone holdout juror in the mistrial.
